basic_info.description: Rarely available, gorgeous John Anderson Victorian on one of Noe Valley's most coveted blocks Lovely details and excellent floor plan: 2300 sq ft, 4 bedrooms, 3.5 baths, an elegant living and dining room with fireplace, and a gourmet chef's kitchen with Wolf and Sub Zero appliances.The primary bedroom and two extra bedrooms are located on the upper level, and the 4th bedroom opens to a lush, level walk-out garden. The house extends with extendable Nano doors to the garden, complete with deck seating and a Big Green Egg BBQ. Hardwood floors, washer/dryer in full laundry room, and a two car garageLocated in the heart of Noe Valley, close to all amenities and a short walk to 24th Street,Can be offered furnished at $13,995 per month. 2023-05-26
